Frequently Asked Questions

Yes. Every Expert Advisor sold on BESTMT4EA.com is fully automated. Once installed on MT4 or MT5, the EA can monitor the market, execute trades, manage risk, and close positions automatically.

What pairs does the EA trade?

A VPS is highly recommended for uninterrupted 24/7 trading. It keeps your MT4 or MT5 platform online even when your personal computer is turned off.

Licensed products are delivered in 6 Hours after successful payment via Telegram.

Apex Quant EA

AI BTCUSD Scalper for MT5

A professional automated trading robot built for BTCUSD — combining AI-assisted market filtering, structured risk control, and adaptive trade management for disciplined, rules-based execution.

Turn BTCUSD’s Volatility Into Consistent, Hands-Free Profit

You don’t need to watch charts all day, guess entries, or survive on willpower to trade BTCUSD well. EA runs a fixed, rule-based scalping system on BTCUSD 24/5 — you set it once, it executes exactly the same way every time.

BUY NOW

★★★★★ Trusted by traders worldwide. Track record verified on Live Trading.

The Problem With Trading BTCUSD Yourself

BTCUSD moves fast and punishes hesitation. Most traders don’t lose because their strategy is bad — they lose because they override it. Moving a stop-loss under pressure. Revenge-trading after a loss. Closing a winner early out of fear. The EA never does any of that. It just runs the plan.

What You Get with the Apex Quant BTCUSD EA: AI Bitcoin Scalper for MT5

Fully automated execution — no manual entries, no screen time required

Fixed rule-based logic — every trade follows the same criteria, no emotion involved

Configurable risk controls — set your own drawdown cap and lot size

Frequently Asked Questions

Which broker do you recommend?

It works best with MT5 – Exness, RoboForex, XM, Fusion Markets broker — this is the tested and recommended broker for stable execution.

Are your Forex EAs fully automated?

Yes. Every Expert Advisor sold on BESTMT4EA.com is fully automated. Once installed on MT4 or MT5, the EA can monitor the market, execute trades, manage risk, and close positions automatically.

How do I install it?

Please check How do I Install an Expert Advisor.

Do you provide installation support?

Yes. We provide step-by-step installation assistance, activation guidance, and troubleshooting support to help you start trading quickly via Telegram.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept secure online payment methods supported by our checkout system (Credit Cards and USDT). Available options may vary depending on your country.

Are updates free?

Yes. Most products include free lifetime updates with performance improvements, bug fixes, and compatibility updates. Product-specific licensing details are listed on each page.

How can I contact support?

You can contact our support team through email and live chat via Telegram. We provide technical assistance for installation, activation, updates, and product-related questions.

What’s the minimum deposit?

We recommend at least $1,000 for stable performance, though some brokers allow lower.

What pairs does the EA trade?

Built and optimized specifically for BTCUSD.

Do I need a VPS?

A VPS is highly recommended for uninterrupted 24/7 trading. It keeps your MT4 or MT5 platform online even when your personal computer is turned off.

What do I receive after purchase?

You’ll receive the Expert Advisor files, installation guide, recommended settings, preset files (if included), lifetime updates for eligible products, and premium customer support via Telegram.

How long does delivery take?

Licensed products are delivered in 6 Hours after successful payment via Telegram.

Can I change the risk settings?

Yes. Most Expert Advisors allow you to adjust lot size, risk percentage, stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, trading sessions, and other parameters.

Does it use Martingale?

Martingale is not required. Compounding can optionally be enabled in settings, but it’s not recommended.

I have no experience with Forex robots. Is it easy to use?

Yes. It’s completely hands-free, and the whole process is 100% automated once installed.

Join traders using EA to run a disciplined, rules-based BTCUSD strategy without watching every candle.

AI EURUSD Scalper for MT5

Turn EURUSD’s Volatility Into Consistent, Hands-Free Profit

Does it use Martingale?

Martingale is not required. Compounding can optionally be enabled in settings, but it’s not recommended.

Yes. It’s completely hands-free, and the whole process is 100% automated once installed.

title.rendered: Windows VPS for MT4 & MT5

content.rendered:
Windows VPS for MT4 & MT5 – Best Price, Ultra-Low Latency, 24/7 Uptime

Windows VPS for MT4 & MT5

Run compatible MetaTrader software on a Windows Server 2022 VPS with 2 CPU cores, 4 GB RAM, 60 GB SSD storage and Remote Desktop access.

VPS Specifications

  • 2 Intel CPU Cores @2.0 GHZ+
  • 4 GB Guaranteed Memory
  • Disk Space 60 GB SSD
  • Bandwidth 1 TB
  • Network Speed 1 Gbps
  • Windows Server 2022
  • Remote Desktop (RDP)
  • 5 – 10 Trading Platforms
Choose Your Plan

Pricing available monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, and annually.

Windows VPS for MT4 & MT5 – Best Price, Ultra-Low Latency, 24/7 Uptime

Run 5–10 MT4 or MT5 platforms simultaneously on a dedicated Windows VPS — optimized for Expert Advisors, algo trading bots, and serious traders who can’t afford downtime.

What Is a Windows VPS?

A Windows VPS is a remotely hosted Windows computer that you access through Remote Desktop. It allows compatible applications such as MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 to keep running without your personal computer needing to stay switched on.

Your VPS operates independently of your local computer and internet connection. If your personal computer is turned off, the VPS can continue running according to the service’s availability and operating conditions.

Why does this matter? When you run MetaTrader Terminal (MT4 or MT5) on a local machine, any interruption — a power cut, a dropped Wi-Fi signal, a Windows update — can close open trades, miss entry signals, or halt your Expert Advisor mid-session. A Windows VPS eliminates that risk entirely.

VPS Specifications

Why Choose This VPS?

Designed for Continuous Operation: Keep compatible Windows applications running without relying on your personal computer being powered on.

Remote Windows Environment: Access your VPS using Remote Desktop from a compatible device — Windows PC, Mac, tablet, or smartphone.

MT4 & MT5 Compatible: Install compatible MetaTrader software and other Windows applications within your VPS environment.

Dedicated Resources: Each plan provides the advertised CPU, memory, storage and network specifications.

Who Can Use This VPS?

MT4/MT5 users — Run compatible MetaTrader installations remotely.

Multiple-platform users — Host multiple compatible applications within the available resources.

Remote workers and frequent travelers — Access a Windows environment from any supported device, anywhere.

Users who need continuous availability — Keep compatible applications running independently of your personal computer or local internet connection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a Windows VPS for MT4 or MT5?

A VPS can be useful if you want to run compatible MT4 or MT5 software remotely without keeping your personal computer switched on. Whether you need one depends on your particular setup.

What is the difference between a Windows VPS and a regular VPS?

A Windows VPS provides a Windows Server environment that can be accessed remotely. This can be useful for users who need Windows-compatible applications such as MT4 and MT5. The appropriate configuration depends on the applications and resources required.

How many MT4 or MT5 instances can I run on this VPS?

This configuration can support approximately 5–10 MT4 or MT5 instances, depending on the number of charts, indicators, Expert Advisors and other applications running simultaneously.

What is RDP and how do I connect?

RDP stands for Remote Desktop Protocol — the standard Windows method for accessing a remote computer as if you were sitting in front of it. After purchasing your VPS, you receive login credentials. On Windows, open the built-in “Remote Desktop Connection” app, enter the VPS IP address and your credentials, and you’re connected. Mac users can use the free Microsoft Remote Desktop app from the App Store.

Will applications continue running when I close my computer?

Applications running on the VPS can continue operating independently of your personal computer, provided the VPS and the applications remain available and properly configured.

What happens if the VPS temporarily becomes unavailable?

Service availability depends on the VPS infrastructure and network. If the VPS becomes temporarily unavailable, applications running on it may stop until service is restored. Open positions, if any, remain subject to the policies and systems of the relevant trading provider.

Can I use this VPS with my broker?

The VPS provides a standard Windows environment suitable for compatible MT4 and MT5 software. Check your broker’s software and system requirements before purchasing.

Do I need technical knowledge to set this up?

No advanced technical knowledge is required. If you can install MetaTrader 4 on a regular PC, you can do the same on a VPS via Remote Desktop. A setup guide is provided with every purchase, and our support team is available to assist if needed.

What operating system does the VPS use?

All plans run Windows Server 2022. The environment provides Remote Desktop access for installing compatible Windows applications.

Can I install software other than MetaTrader on the VPS?

Yes. You can install supported Windows-compatible applications, subject to the VPS resources, software licensing requirements and provider policies.

How do I choose the right billing plan?

Choose based on how long you plan to use the service:
Monthly — Ideal for testing or short-term use.
Quarterly — Suitable for a medium-term commitment.
Semi-Annually — Best value for consistent, ongoing use.
Annually — Maximum savings for long-term dedicated use.

Payment Methods

Mastercard, Visa, USDT and other supported payment methods are available at checkout.

Get Your Windows VPS

Run compatible Windows applications remotely without keeping your personal computer switched on. Choose the plan that matches your required resources and billing period.

Choose Your VPS Plan

Pricing available monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, and annually.

FXCore100 EA

EURUSD Scalper for MT4

A professional automated trading robot built for EURUSD — combining AI-assisted market filtering, structured risk control, and adaptive trade management for disciplined, rules-based execution.

Turn EURUSD’s Volatility Into Consistent, Hands-Free Profit

You don’t need to watch charts all day, guess entries, or survive on willpower to trade EURUSD well. EA runs a fixed, rule-based scalping system on EURUSD 24/5 — you set it once, it executes exactly the same way every time.

Get Lifetime Access Now

★★★★★ Trusted by traders worldwide

The Problem With Trading EURUSD Yourself

EURUSD moves fast and punishes hesitation. Most traders don’t lose because their strategy is bad — they lose because they override it. Moving a stop-loss under pressure. Revenge-trading after a loss. Closing a winner early out of fear. The EA never does any of that. It just runs the plan.

What You Get with the FXCore100 EA for MT4

Fully automated execution — no manual entries, no screen time required

Fixed rule-based logic — every trade follows the same criteria, no emotion involved

Configurable risk controls — set your own drawdown cap and lot size

Free lifetime updates — the strategy improves, you don’t pay again

24/7 Telegram support — real answers, not a ticket queue

Backtest Report

Recommended Money Management

Developers recommend using the default setting of the FXCore100 EA. Without adjusting any settings on the EA. The following account size is suitable for the following timeframe for Low-risk trading or equivalent Micro/Cent account.

$200 to $1000 for H4
$2000 to $4000 for H1
$5000 to $10,000 for 30M
$11000 to $16000 for 15M
$17,000 to $30,000 for 5M
$31,000 to $50,000 for 1M

BUY NOW

Limited Time Offer: Download your trial today and test risk-free on demo accounts.

Who Should Buy

Good fit

Traders who want rules-based EURUSD exposure without watching charts all day; traders who already use an ECN broker with tight spreads; traders comfortable running EAs on a VPS.

Not a fit

Traders looking for a “set and forget, never check it” system with zero risk; anyone unwilling to test on demo first; accounts under the recommended minimum equity.

Installation

1 Download the EA file after purchase.
2 Copy it into your MT4 Experts folder.
3 Restart MT4 and drag the EA onto your chart.
4 Enable AutoTrading and apply the recommended settings.

What’s Included

Expert Advisor file

Free lifetime updates

Premium Telegram support

License activation for your account(s)

Forex EA vs. Manual Trading

What Traders Are Saying

Verified Buyer

The live stats give me real peace of mind — I can see exactly what the EA is doing.

Verified Buyer

Setup took 10 minutes, and I’m seeing steady gains. Support is always quick to respond.

Verified Buyer

Quick setup and reliable performance. Seeing consistent gains has made trading enjoyable again.

Individual results vary and are not typical of every user. Testimonials reflect specific customer experiences and do not guarantee future performance.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which broker do you recommend?

It works best with MT4 – Exness, RoboForex, XM, Fusion Markets broker — this is the tested and recommended broker for stable execution.

Are your Forex EAs fully automated?

Yes. Every Expert Advisor sold on BESTMT4EA.com is fully automated. Once installed on MT4 or MT5, the EA can monitor the market, execute trades, manage risk, and close positions automatically.

How do I install it?

Please check How do I Install an Expert Advisor.

Do you provide installation support?

Yes. We provide step-by-step installation assistance, activation guidance, and troubleshooting support to help you start trading quickly via Telegram.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept secure online payment methods supported by our checkout system (Credit Cards and USDT). Available options may vary depending on your country.

Are updates free?

Yes. Most products include free lifetime updates with performance improvements, bug fixes, and compatibility updates. Product-specific licensing details are listed on each page.

How can I contact support?

You can contact our support team through email and live chat via Telegram. We provide technical assistance for installation, activation, updates, and product-related questions.

What’s the minimum deposit?

We recommend at least $1,000 for stable performance, though some brokers allow lower.

What pairs does the EA trade?

Built and optimized specifically for EURUSD.

Do I need a VPS?

A VPS is highly recommended for uninterrupted 24/7 trading. It keeps your MT4 or MT5 platform online even when your personal computer is turned off.

What do I receive after purchase?

You’ll receive the Expert Advisor files, installation guide, recommended settings, preset files (if included), lifetime updates for eligible products, and premium customer support via Telegram.

How long does delivery take?

Licensed products are delivered in 6 Hours after successful payment via Telegram.

Can I change the risk settings?

Yes. Most Expert Advisors allow you to adjust lot size, risk percentage, stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, trading sessions, and other parameters.

Does it use Martingale?

Martingale is not required. Compounding can optionally be enabled in settings, but it’s not recommended.

I have no experience with Forex robots. Is it easy to use?

Yes. It’s completely hands-free, and the whole process is 100% automated once installed.
